title: PDMS Fabrication
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yadfsa6

steps.title: Clean Petri Dish Lid
steps.instruction: Wipe the inside of the petri dish lid with 70% ethanol solution using a Kimwipe® to remove debris.

steps.title: Prepare Silanization Chamber
steps.instruction: Place the petri dish lid(s) and a 10 cm × 10 cm piece of aluminum foil in a desiccator located in the fume hood.

steps.title: Apply Silanizing Agent
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL Tridecafluoro-1,1,2,2-tetrahydrooctyl trichlorosilane to the aluminum foil, ensuring no inhalation or skin contact due to the corrosive nature of the chemical.

steps.title: Vaporize Reagent under Vacuum
steps.instruction: Dessicate the assembly under vacuum for 15 minutes to vaporize the reagent.

substeps.instruction: Press down on the lid while applying vacuum
Verify vacuum is achieved by ensuring the lid can be lifted

steps.title: Prepare PDMS Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine PDMS curing agent and PDMS polymer in a 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Mix PDMS Solution
steps.instruction: Mix the solution using an inoculation loop for approximately 5 minutes until small bubbles are present throughout the solution.

steps.title: Cast PDMS in Petri Dish
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixed PDMS into the petri dish and spread evenly by tilting.

substeps.instruction: Use a pipette tip or inoculation loop to ensure all polymer is removed from the tube

steps.title: Cure PDMS
steps.instruction: Cover the petri dish with aluminum foil and place it on a hot plate at 120 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Analysis
steps.instruction: Cut a piece of PDMS approximately 1 cm × 1 cm using a blade and place it on a glass microscope slide for water contact angle analysis.
